rawContent: I confronted a man yesterday who I did something to me that made me afraid/upset for a long time. He had no idea the emotional impact it had on me, and now he knows.  If it wasn't for the #MeToo movement, I'm not sure I would've been taken seriously or believed. But now, I am.

I'm honestly really downtrodden after weeks of this #MeToo stuff. Ideally it's a watershed moment in the long term, but wow does it hurt in the short term. Surprise: It's a lot to have a lifetime of stuff surface collectively amongst half the population.

Weeks of #MeToo have turnt me out from Terminator 1 Sarah Connor to Terminator 2 Sarah Connor. But the guns are my emotions & the robots are all the fuckin asshole guys in my life's worst memories. https://t.co/Vaz8rdWAon

Immediately after the #MeToo watershed moment of women sharing rape & violence they have been subjected to at the hands of men- women are banned & silenced for saying "men are scum" on @facebook #MenAreScum
